Number.isFinite(n)?n:d}function read(name){try{return $(name).all().map(i=>i.json||{})}catch{return[]}}function table(name,headers){const rows=read(name);if(!rows.length)return[];if(headers.every(h=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rows[0],h)))return rows;const idx=rows.findIndex(r=>{const vals=Object.values(r).map(clean);return headers.every(h=>vals.includes(h))});if(idx<0)return rows;const hr=rows[idx],keys=Object.keys(hr).filter(k=>k!=='row_number'),names=keys.map(k=>clean(hr[k]));return rows.slice(idx+1).map(r=>{const o={};keys.forEach((k,i)=>{if(names[i])o[names[i]]=r[k]});return o}).filter(r=>Object.values(r).some(v=>clean(v)))}function time(v){const t=new Date(v||0).getTime();return Number.isFinite(t)?t:0}const settingsRows=table('GS — SETTINGS',['Setting','Value','Type','Meaning']);const settings={};settingsRows.forEach(r=>{if(clean(r.Setting))settings[clean(r.Setting)]=r.Value});const queue=table('GS — PITCH_QUEUE',['Pitch_ID','Created_At','Track_ID','Track_Name','Source_ID','Source_Name','Status']);const logs=table('GS — SUBMISSION_LOG',['Log_ID','Pitch_ID','Sent_At','Track_ID','Track_Name','Source_ID','Source_Name','Status']);const metrics=table('GS — WEEKLY_METRICS',['Week_Start','Monthly_Listeners','Followers','Streams_7d']).sort((a,b)=>time(b.Week_Start)-time(a.Week_Start));const now=Date.now(),cutoff=now-7*86400000;const recentLogs=logs.filter(r=>time(r.Sent_At)>=cutoff||time(r.Reply_At)>=cutoff||time(r.Placement_At)>=cutoff);const sent=recentLogs.filter(r=>clean(r.Status)==='SENT'||clean(r.Sent_At));const replies=recentLogs.filter(r=>clean(r.Reply_At)||['REPLY_FOUND','POSITIVE_REPLY','NEGATIVE_REPLY'].includes(clean(r.Status)));const placements=recentLogs.filter(r=>clean(r.Placement_At)||clean(r.Placement_URL)||clean(r.Status)==='PLACED');const errors=recentLogs.filter(r=>clean(r.Status)==='ERROR'||clean(r.Error));const recipients=new Set(sent.map(r=>clean(r.Contact_Email||r.Recipient||r.Source_ID)).filter(Boolean));const logged=new Set(logs.map(r=>clean(r.Pitch_ID)).filter(Boolean));const pending=queue.filter(r=>['PENDING_MANUAL','REVIEW_REQUIRED','READY_DRY_RUN'].includes(clean(r.Status))&&!logged.has(clean(r.Pitch_ID))).sort((a,b)=>num(b.Fit_Score,0)-num(a.Fit_Score,0));const today=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('sv-SE',{timeZone:'Europe/Warsaw',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());const followups=logs.filter(r=>clean(r.Status)==='SENT'&&clean(r.Follow_Up_At)&&clean(r.Follow_Up_At)<=today&&!clean(r.Reply_At));const replyRate=sent.length?Math.round(replies.length/sent.length*100):0;const placementRate=sent.length?Math.round(placements.length/sent.length*100):0;const latest=metrics[0]||{};const listeners=num(latest.Monthly_Listeners,num(settings.CURRENT_MONTHLY_LISTENERS,0));const actions=[];errors.slice(0,1).forEach(r=>actions.push('Napraw błąd: '+clean(r.Track_Name)+' → '+clean(r.Source_Name)));followups.slice(0,1).forEach(r=>actions.push('Zdecyduj o follow-upie: '+clean(r.Track_Name)+' → '+clean(r.Source_Name)));pending.slice(0,3-actions.length).forEach(r=>actions.push('Ręczny pitch: '+clean(r.Track_Name)+' → '+clean(r.Source_Name)+' ['+clean(r.Fit_Score)+']'));const actionLines=actions.length?actions.map((x,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+x).join(NL):'Brak pilnych działań.';const content=['📊 **VIRYA — wynik playlist pitching / 7 dni**','Wysłane: '+sent.length+' | unikalni odbiorcy: '+recipients.size,'Odpowiedzi: '+replies.length+' ('+replyRate+'%) | placementy: '+placements.length+' ('+placementRate+'%)','Błędy: '+errors.length+' | ręczne oczekujące: '+pending.length+' | follow-upy: '+followups.length,'Spotify: '+(listeners||'uzupełnij baseline')+' słuchaczy | streams 7d: '+(clean(latest.Streams_7d)||'—')+' | saves: '+(clean(latest.Saves_7d)||'—'),'**3 następne działania**',actionLines,'Arkusz: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ksa6VePLgLQESHvJL-_zBZ2KzVNHYPndzwhXvVj4Vxw/edit'].join(NL+NL);return[{json:{content:content.slice(0,1950),allowed_mentions:{parse:[]}}}];

## WEEKLY DIGEST
Piątek 11:00: wysłane maile, błędy, odpowiedzi, placementy, zaległe ręczne formularze, follow-upy i progres do 1000 słuchaczy.

Po imporcie wybierz thread Playlisty w node Discord. Node Code zwraca wiele itemów, dlatego Discord nie może mieć Execute Once.
